description: SIDD-Medium fitting crops per camera-ISO class and the 40 SIDD Validation images. A fit key '<capture>/<image>/<k>' is crop k (row-major 256-pixel grid plus a last crop flush with the far edge) of <capture>/<id>_{GT,NOISY}_SRGB_<image>.PNG. About 20% of each class's training captures are held out of fitting. Two crops of capture 0050 with corrupt PNG files in the original cache are excluded.
